en.titre:
10/10 hobbies for adhd brains
that aren't the gym

en.accroche: the music tells you _exactly_ when to _move_
colonne: you count the beat, follow a partner and learn a new step every class, so there's no room to _drift off_
en.chute: most studios have a free first class

en.accroche: one painting is a _puzzle_, not a _wall_
colonne: who is this, why that light, what's hidden in the corner: a curious brain locks in when there's a _story_ to find
_pro tip_: i use artura, one artwork a day with its story, zooming into the details you'd miss
en.chute: then go see one in real life and count what you notice

en.accroche: the river _keeps moving_, so you _do too_
colonne: every stroke steers you, the water changes all the time, and you can't check your phone with a _paddle_ in your hands
en.chute: rent one for an hour at the nearest lake

en.accroche: soft sand, a _sunset_ and _no gym mirrors_
colonne: running outside gives a restless brain open space, and a goal like a first 5k gives it a _reason_ to come back
_pro tip_: i use atala, an ai running coach that plans my week around my goal
en.chute: go at golden hour and run on the wet sand

colonne: watering, planting and checking the leaves are small daily tasks, and the results show up _fast_ enough to stay hooked
en.chute: start with herbs on a windowsill
